# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 stable release** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m151 and reduces common managed allocations. The release improves color conversion, parsing, shaping, and WebAssembly delivery while preserving the managed API surface.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — Includes the m151 engine update and subsequent upstream bug-fix merges. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Color, parsing, and shaping allocations reduced** — Moves common color conversions to managed code and avoids transient allocations in tag parsing and text shaping. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388))

## Bug Fixes

- **Encoded image subset resources are released correctly** — Fixes a native resource leak when decoding a subset from encoded image data. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))

## Platform

- **.NET 11 WebAssembly assets updated** — Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries with current exception-handling support for WebAssembly applications. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Makes UTF-8 shaping and tag parsing allocation-conscious while refreshing WebAssembly HarfBuzz delivery.
